contract.principle: Absence of CURRENT_DATA must not erase admitted historical or structural knowledge.
contract.currentOverlay: Optional. Current values may overlay structural knowledge only when dated and admitted.
contract.unknownContainment: UNKNOWN is limited to the specific unresolved field; it must not replace the whole customer card when structural knowledge exists.

structuralProfile.zh: 东南亚不是单一运行体，而是由不同国家发展路径、海洋贸易通道、制造业节点、资源经济与大都市网络叠加形成的区域系统。区域整合加强跨境连接，但并未消除国家之间在产业、治理、人口与基础设施条件上的差异。
structuralProfile.en: Southeast Asia is not a single runtime. It is a regional system formed by overlapping national development paths, maritime trade corridors, manufacturing nodes, resource economies, and metropolitan networks. Regional integration increases cross-border connection without removing major differences in industry, governance, demography, and infrastructure.

structuralPressures.zh: 城市与基础设施承载：人口与资本向都市圈集中，使交通、住房、公共服务与灾害韧性成为长期结构压力。
structuralPressures.en: Urban and infrastructure load: concentration of people and capital in metropolitan areas places long-run pressure on transport, housing, public services, and disaster resilience.

structuralPressures.zh: 产业位置与技能：制造、服务与数字经济升级扩大了机会，同时提高技能、供应链位置与生产率差异的重要性。
structuralPressures.en: Industrial position and skills: upgrading in manufacturing, services, and the digital economy expands opportunity while increasing the importance of skills, supply-chain position, and productivity gaps.

structuralPressures.zh: 外部需求与地缘连接：贸易、投资、航运与大国关系使区域持续暴露于外部周期与战略再平衡。
structuralPressures.en: External demand and geopolitical connection: trade, investment, shipping, and major-power relations keep the region exposed to external cycles and strategic rebalancing.

reconfigurationAxes.zh: 制造与供应链位置持续重排：部分经济体从低成本组装向更复杂的制造、物流与服务节点移动。
reconfigurationAxes.en: Manufacturing and supply-chain positions continue to be rearranged as some economies move from low-cost assembly toward more complex manufacturing, logistics, and service roles.

reconfigurationAxes.zh: 城市系统继续扩张：大都市圈与第二城市成为就业、住房、交通和公共服务压力汇集处。
reconfigurationAxes.en: Urban systems continue to expand, making metropolitan regions and second-tier cities key sites where jobs, housing, transport, and public-service pressures converge.

reconfigurationAxes.zh: 区域连接深化但保持多中心：跨境生产、数字平台、交通与金融连接增强，同时国家政策与发展模式仍保持显著差异。
reconfigurationAxes.en: Regional connection deepens while remaining polycentric: cross-border production, digital platforms, transport, and finance intensify even as national policies and development models remain distinct.

signals.zh: 供应链节点、港口与物流能力的重要性上升。
signals.en: Supply-chain nodes, ports, and logistics capacity are becoming more consequential.

signals.zh: 住房、通勤与城市公共服务越来越直接影响个人可用收入与时间。
signals.en: Housing, commuting, and urban public services increasingly shape disposable income and usable time.

signals.zh: 青年技能、跨境流动与数字接入逐渐决定谁能够进入新机会。
signals.en: Youth skills, cross-border mobility, and digital access increasingly shape who can enter new opportunities.

unknowns.zh: 尚未接入经过 PHI OS 验收的 2026 区域统一 current-value 数据集，因此不显示即时数值、排序或确定性方向判断。
unknowns.en: A PHI OS-admitted unified 2026 regional current-value dataset is not yet connected, so no live values, rankings, or deterministic direction claims are shown.

livingEnvironment.zh: 区域重组通过城市扩张、交通、基础服务与气候暴露进入生活环境。同一国家内部的大都市、二线城市、工业区、岛屿与农村可能处于完全不同的基础设施现实。
livingEnvironment.en: Regional reconfiguration reaches living conditions through urban expansion, transport, basic services, and climate exposure. Metropolitan areas, secondary cities, industrial zones, islands, and rural areas within the same country can occupy very different infrastructure realities.

employmentOpportunity.zh: 制造迁移、旅游、数字服务、资源产业与跨境资本改变就业入口。机会不仅取决于国家增长，还取决于个人是否连接到更高生产率产业与城市网络。
employmentOpportunity.en: Manufacturing relocation, tourism, digital services, resource sectors, and cross-border capital reshape entry to work. Opportunity depends not only on national growth but also on whether people are connected to higher-productivity industries and urban networks.

incomeCostBalance.zh: 收入改善可能被住房、交通、食品、教育与医疗成本吸收。判断生活是否真正改善，需要同时读取收入能力与必要支出，而不是只看名义工资。
incomeCostBalance.en: Income gains can be absorbed by housing, transport, food, education, and healthcare costs. Whether life materially improves therefore requires reading earning power together with necessary expenditure, not nominal wages alone.

housingPressure.zh: 住房是宏观重组进入家庭现实最直接的接口之一。土地、人口集中、信贷、租赁供给与基础设施扩张速度共同决定城市增长最终表现为资产机会还是居住负担。
housingPressure.en: Housing is one of the most direct interfaces between macro reconfiguration and household reality. Land, population concentration, credit, rental supply, and infrastructure expansion jointly determine whether urban growth becomes an asset opportunity or a housing burden.

personalFutureCapacity.zh: 个人未来容量不是乐观程度，而是一个人是否仍拥有学习、迁移、转职、储蓄与建立长期计划的现实空间。教育、住房负担、数字接入、职业流动与家庭责任会共同扩大或压缩这种空间。
personalFutureCapacity.en: Personal future capacity is not optimism. It is the practical room a person retains to learn, move, change work, save, and build long-term plans. Education, housing burden, digital access, career mobility, and family obligations jointly expand or compress that room.

structuralProfile.zh: 高度城市化、金融与技术网络、全国市场与州级差异共同塑造运行结构。
structuralProfile.en: A highly urbanized economy, financial and technology networks, a continental market, and major state-level differences jointly shape the runtime.

structuralPressures.zh: 结构压力需要从人口、产业、城市、基础设施与外部依赖的组合中读取，而不是以单一指标代表整体。
structuralPressures.en: Structural pressure must be read across demography, industry, cities, infrastructure, and external dependency rather than reduced to a single indicator.

structuralPressures.zh: 区域或国家内部差异可能大于整体平均值所显示的差异。
structuralPressures.en: Internal regional or national differences may be larger than aggregate averages suggest.

reconfigurationAxes.zh: 产业、技术与基础设施的位置变化会重新分配机会与负担。
reconfigurationAxes.en: Changes in the position of industry, technology, and infrastructure redistribute opportunity and burden.

reconfigurationAxes.zh: 人口、城市与制度调整会改变个人能够进入资源和服务的路径。
reconfigurationAxes.en: Demographic, urban, and institutional adjustment changes how people can access resources and services.

signals.zh: 观察产业位置、城市压力、人口变化与基础设施投资是否持续改变运行结构。
signals.en: Observe whether shifts in industrial position, urban pressure, demography, and infrastructure investment persistently alter the runtime.

signals.zh: 观察家庭成本、就业入口与迁移路径是否同步发生变化。
signals.en: Observe whether household costs, entry to work, and mobility pathways change together.

unknowns.zh: 当前即时数值、短期方向与量化强度必须等待经过时效性与来源验收的数据；结构知识不因此被删除。
unknowns.en: Live values, short-term direction, and quantitative intensity must await dated and admitted evidence; structural knowledge is not erased in the meantime.

livingEnvironment.zh: 生活环境通过城市形态、基础服务、交通、环境暴露与地区差异承接宏观重组。
livingEnvironment.en: Living conditions transmit macro reconfiguration through urban form, basic services, transport, environmental exposure, and regional differences.

employmentOpportunity.en: Employment opportunity depends on industrial position, skill thresholds, firm structure, and geographic access, not only aggregate employment totals.

incomeCostBalance.en: Income must be read together with essential costs such as housing, transport, food, education, healthcare, and care work.
